name: The Taxman's Shakedown
summary: You flashed wealth in the open market, and Ode the tax-collector, scenting coin, has latched on.
narrative_beats: A hand settles on your stall cloth. It is Ode, his silver buckle bright in the dusk.
'Madam, from so far away — saffron is no common ware.' He smiles gently. 'The town coffers have been a little empty of late.'
player_options: Bribe him (coins-, no suspicion rise; he'll be harder next time)
Argue the price down (success cuts the loss; failure raises suspicion)
Let the Maestro draw a frightening note (instant escape, but bystanders stare → quiet suspicion rise)
consequences: Bribe: coins drop; Ode marks you as 'one who pays' and turns up more often.
Use the spirit: no tax this time, but suspicion creeps up, and the inquisitor's men may hear of 'strange doings in the market.'
